# theme-juice

**Tag**: cli, devops

## 简介

tj helps you create new local WordPress development sites, manage existing sites, and deploy them, all from the command line.

## 官网

- 主页: http://themejuice.it
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ezekg/theme-juice-cli
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/ezekg/theme-juice-cli/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/theme-juice
